ballPolicy: Leo's basketball is separate runtime/game art. He gathers the ball into his patient shooting pocket and releases once from his right fingertips on frame5 at simulation tick13; the ball is never painted into the poses.

cleanup.method: retain ten major alpha-connected figures; remove nonbody haze/specks beyond two-pixel antialias dilation; baseline and uniformly scale all poses to one 5x2 sheet

review.reviewNotes: Ten distinct full-body right-facing jump-shot poses show patient gather, set, release, follow-through and recovery. Leo remains a pale adult human with long wavy black hair, refined mustache, composed face and controlled black/crimson uniform. The hands are empty and the external ball releases at frame5/tick13. The cleanup removes surrounding transparency haze while keeping all ten bodies intact.
